message.content: Based on the conversation, Gavriel expresses a preference for turn-based combat. This preference is evident from statements such as, "I really enjoy turn-based combat! It gives you time to think and plan your moves without feeling rushed." Additionally, Gavriel notes that he finds turn-based games satisfying because "Every move counts a bit more" and he enjoys the depth it offers in battles. This aligns with his enthusiasm for games like "Persona 5 Royal," which he describes as having "strategic battles" and appreciates the balance of RPG elements and social simulation.
